source.title: Irish News, 3 June 1955, p. 1 ("Rural council election results")
source.publisher: Irish News (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)

note: Triennial election of the seventeen electoral divisions of Kilkeel rural district, one member each, polled Thursday 2 June 1955. Two divisions were contested, Ballymartin and Glassdrumman; the other fifteen were returned unopposed (Newry Telegraph, 21 May 1955, p. 3).
correctionNote: Renamed from 'Glassdrumman' to Glasdrumman (19 Nov 2026, w19-tidy, the owner's decision 4 of 19 Nov 2026: a division filed under two spellings takes its official name, and each round keeps the spelling it was filed under as Constituency_Name_As_Printed): the Northern Ireland DED maps of 1921-69 name the DED Glasdrumman; the rounds were filed as Glassdrummond (1924, 1939); Glasdrumman (1927, 1930, 1936, 1961, 1964, 1967); Glassdrumman (1933, 1946, 1949, 1955, 1958); Glasdrummond (1952). This round was filed as 'Glassdrumman', kept as Constituency_Name_As_Printed; the old address (glassdrumman) answers with a redirect to this one.
